fields.label: Label
fields.description: Printed on the statement exactly as entered here, e.g. 'GOSI Payment'.

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: Which side of the statement this line prints on. A single account can back a Cash Out line and a Cash In line separately — see each binding's Direction Mode, not this field, for how the two are told apart.

fields.label: Section
fields.description: Groups lines under a shared header on the statement, e.g. 'Operating', 'Financing'. Free text on purpose — this is a print grouping, not a coded taxonomy.

fields.label: Sort Key
fields.description: Print order within its section. Lower first.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive lines are kept (their history stays on past runs) but excluded from new runs and from the Line Setup list.

fields.label: Bindings
fields.description: One or more accounts (any root type) this line reads from. A line with zero bindings never errors — it simply contributes nothing, the same 'blank vs zero' distinction the rest of the app uses — but it also never appears in the reconciliation as a source of residual, which makes an accidentally-unbound line easy to miss. Check Line Setup's binding count, not just the statement, before trusting a run.

fields.label: Dimension field
fields.description: v2.86.6 — no longer restricted to Cash In. Your own Cash Out lines need this too (Kafaa Project Allowance, Municipalities Project Per Diem) — they're project/department-specific the same way Collection is, just on the spending side. Set which GL Entry field carries the distinction here, then set the matching value(s) on each binding row below.
